s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing eyelid mass with recent changes and crust formation
salient_findings: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the central lower eyelid
Flakier surface at one lateral end
Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and neoplastic squamous cell proliferation
key_facts: 4-year history of a left lower eyelid mass
Recent growth and crust formation
Papule is well-circumscribed and located on the central lower eyelid
Tumor has a flakier surface at one lateral end
Specimen measured 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells
Malignant squamous cells have eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
Mitotic figures are present
Central areas of clear cell change are periodic acid-Schiff positive and diastase sensitive

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, mitotic figures, and proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells

shortlist.label: Verrucous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts and recent crust formation

shortlist.label: Keratoacanthoma
shortlist.why_kept: Well-circumscribed papule with a flakier surface at one lateral end and hyperkeratotic features

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ with invasive components
shortlist.why_kept: Clear cell change and diastase-sensitive periodic acid-Schiff positivity, with invasive components

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma with clear cell features
shortlist.why_kept: Central areas of clear cell change and malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm

raw.rationale: The presence of malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, along with mitotic figures, indicates a malignant process, which is more consistent with Squamous Cell Carcinoma than Keratoacanthoma

rejected.label: Keratoacanthoma
rejected.why: Keratoacanthoma typically has a more benign course and lacks the malignant features seen in this case, such as mitotic figures and prominent nucleoli
